notable_issues: artifact_kind drifted to candidate or missing candidate suffix
ambiguous no-pointer row used lookup_required_later instead of not_applicable
row shapes often remained plain strings
canonical_pointer field ambiguity: exact-menu rows used ui.menu rather than full CREATE ui.menu@v1

observed_strengths: The hardened shape substantially reduced candidate/tentative decoration inside parseable fields.
Splitting raw_pointer_candidate from canonical_pointer improved unknown and opaque pointer handling.
All specimens kept unknown, opaque, and ambiguous cases fail-closed.
All specimens avoided implementation, runtime, obligation expansion, and next-family authority.
The object_class/object_version split worked well across both model families.
observed_failure_modes: The prompt underspecified canonical_pointer: exact-menu rows interpreted it as object pointer ui.menu rather than full semantic pointer CREATE ui.menu@v1.
Row shapes were still not closed: uncertainty, negative-cue, and forbidden-inference rows varied between strings and objects.
Harness-owned session refs remained null, unknown, or ad hoc because no harness supplied them.
Mini still struggled with exact artifact_kind and raw pointer preservation under unknown-class pressure.
resident_model_competency_claims often came back empty when row schema was not specified.
recommended_harness_hardening: Rename canonical_pointer to canonical_semantic_pointer and require full operator/class/version form, or remove it and derive it from proposed_operator + object_class + object_version.
Add raw_object_pointer and canonical_object_pointer if object-only pointer values are useful.
Define exact row schemas for uncertainty_rows, negative_cue_rows, forbidden_inference_rows, and resident_model_competency_claims.
Have the harness inject semantic_declaration_session_ref rather than asking the model to invent it.
Make artifact_kind an enum or harness-provided constant.
Use deterministic post-parse normalization only for display fields, not for authority-bearing canonical fields.
